stack.hygiene_rule: TypeScript `strict: true`, zero `any` (`no-explicit-any` is an error), no non-null `!` without a comment; Python: full type hints on every public function, no bare `except:`, no mutable default arguments
stack.hygiene_check: zero `any`, no `console.log`; type hints on every public function, no bare `except:`, no `print` in `api/`
stack.env_convention: `.env` git-ignored, `.env.example` committed with every variable; `VITE_` vars ship to the browser and never hold a secret
stack.secret_locations: `.env` on this machine and Fly.io secrets in production
stack.boundaries: FastAPI request models, React forms, env, the Stripe webhook payload
stack.discipline_rule: React 18 + Vite SPA — no React-19 APIs, no server components, no `next/*`; routing library is ⚠️ undecided — do not assume one.
stack.discipline_line: React 18 APIs only; Tailwind v4 CSS-first; Python typed and ruff-clean
stack.stack_checks: React 18 + Vite only (no React-19 or Next APIs); Tailwind v4 CSS-first (no `tailwind.config`); FastAPI request models for every input; Alembic for every schema change
stack.stack_violation: a React-19 / Next API, a Stripe call outside `api/app/services/payments.py`, a schema change without an Alembic migration
stack.styling_rule: Tailwind v4 CSS-first — no config file; tokens in `web/src/styles/tokens.css`; dynamic classes through the class-merge helper.
stack.client_rule: One database session per request from `api/app/db/session.py` — never instantiate another engine or session.
stack.server_unit_names: FastAPI routes in `api/app/routers/` calling services in `api/app/services/`
stack.access_control_rule: Every new table design states which of translator / agency / admin can read and write which rows, enforced in the service layer.
stack.access_control_check: Per-role access stated for every new table and route
stack.impl_order: Alembic migration → SQLAlchemy model → service → router + request/response models → `web/src/types/`
stack.ui_impl_order: i18n keys → hook → component → page wiring → route
stack.error_shape: a typed `HTTPException` with a stable error code the web app maps to a message
stack.data_layer_summary: the FastAPI API (`api/**`): Postgres schema and Alembic migrations, SQLAlchemy models, services incl. the money module and Stripe integration, routers, auth, and the shared types in `web/src/types/`
stack.ui_territory_summary: the React web app (`web/src/**` except `types/`): components, pages, hooks, i18n, styling and accessibility
stack.data_principles: Index what you filter; every schema change is an Alembic migration; `updated_at` on every table; money as integer minor units with the currency beside it.
stack.data_change_shape: Alembic migration, tables/columns/constraints, per-role access in the service layer, indexes with rationale
stack.flow_shape: migration → model → service → router → `web/src/types/` → hook → component
stack.stack_edge_cases: currency rounding and FX capture, webhook replay from Stripe, session expiry mid-form
stack.early_items_step: Add i18n keys to `web/src/i18n/en.json` and `es.json` and any shared types first so nothing downstream blocks.

migration.rule: Never edit an applied migration; at most one unapplied Alembic migration exists at a time; `alembic upgrade head` runs locally only — production is user-gated.
migration.state_step: Check `alembic current` and `api/alembic/versions/` before creating a migration.

money.rule: Money is integer minor units in the invoice currency, never floats. All money arithmetic imports from `api/app/services/money.py` — never inlined. After touching it, run `make test` and quote the output.

stack.security_examples: a service that skips the role check, a Stripe secret in `VITE_` vars or a log, a client-side mutation of invoice totals

risk.surfaces: money and currency math, auth and permissions, migrations on the live database, the Stripe integration
risk.critical: a fee or FX miscalculation, an invoice visible to the wrong client
risk.escalation: money math, auth, a migration, or Stripe
risk.rule: Money is integer minor units; every payment design shows the calculation explicitly and routes arithmetic through pure functions in `api/app/services/money.py`, naming which must be unit-tested.
risk.check: All money arithmetic imported from `api/app/services/money.py` as integer minor units; every schema change is an Alembic migration
qa_sections: **Money & currency** — amounts are integer minor units with a currency; the 2.5 % fee uses the 50-minor-unit floor and half-up rounding from `money.py`; FX captured at creation and never recomputed; a changed value in `money.py` turns a test red.
**Auth & permissions** — every router checks the session and the role; a translator never reads another translator's invoices; agency sees only invoices addressed to it.
**Migrations** — one unapplied Alembic migration at most; reversible `downgrade`; no data loss on existing rows.
**Stripe** — calls only in `api/app/services/payments.py`; webhook signature verified; replayed events idempotent by event id; test mode locally.

gated.deploy_commands: `fly deploy` · `alembic upgrade head` against production (`DATABASE_URL` pointing at Fly)

design.token_source: CSS variables in `web/src/styles/tokens.css` (⚠️ undecided — create with the approved direction)
design.conventions: No component library; class-merge helper `web/src/lib/cn.ts`; icons ⚠️ undecided

gotchas: - **Tailwind v4 is CSS-first** — there is no `tailwind.config.*`; tokens and theme live in `web/src/styles/tokens.css`.
- **Routing library is ⚠️ undecided** — do not import `react-router` or anything else until it is chosen and written here.
- **i18n keys go in both `en.json` and `es.json`** with `{{var}}` interpolation — a key in one file is a 🔴.
- **Stripe is called only from `api/app/services/payments.py`** — test mode locally; the live CLI is user-gated.
- **`alembic upgrade head` runs routinely against the local DB** — against production only on the user's word.
- **`.env` is readable and editable** by agents; its values never reach a commit, a log or a report; `.env.example` documents every variable.
architecture: - Monorepo: `web/` (React 18 + Vite SPA) and `api/` (FastAPI); gates run from the root through the root `package.json` workspace scripts and the root `Makefile`.
- API: `api/app/routers/` → `api/app/services/` → SQLAlchemy models in `api/app/models/`; one session per request from `api/app/db/session.py`; Alembic migrations in `api/alembic/versions/`.
- Auth: session cookies; roles table with `translator`, `agency`, `admin`; the service layer enforces per-role access — the UI only hides.
- Payments: Stripe in `api/app/services/payments.py`; webhooks verified and idempotent by event id.
- Shared types for the web app in `web/src/types/` (owned by backend-developer).
business_rules: | Platform fee | 2.5 % of invoice total, minimum 50 minor units of the invoice currency, rounded half-up |
| Amount storage | integer minor units in the invoice currency, currency stored beside the amount |
| FX rate | captured at invoice creation, never recomputed |
| Refund window | ⚠️ undecided — ask before implementing |
Money module: `api/app/services/money.py` — pure functions, integer minor units, unit-tested; nothing inlines money arithmetic.
data_rules: - Every schema change is an Alembic migration; never edit an applied one; at most one unapplied at a time.
- Per-role access is enforced in the service layer on every query; least privilege by default.
- `alembic upgrade head` against production and `fly deploy` need the user's explicit go-ahead.
